Hi Tom — welcome, and thanks for the clear timeline. Looping in Marissa (Procurement Ops) and Karthik (Legal lead) so we have the right owners on the thread.

Attached is our vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx which lists what we need from you and what Redwood will provide. High level:
- From Nimbus (due ASAP): completed onboarding worksheet, signed MSA or redlines (if any), W-9, bank remit info (PDF), proof of insurance if available.
- From Redwood (we will): PO example & standard payment terms (net 30), supplier portal invite, and initial integration contact for engineering.

PO timeline (estimate, assumes paperwork returned within 3 business days):
1) Day 0–1: Nimbus returns completed worksheet + W-9 + bank stub
2) Day 1–2: Marissa validates vendor records and issues portal invite
3) Day 3–5: Finance creates PO draft and sends for internal approval
4) Day 5–7: Final PO sent to Nimbus; first invoice can be processed on receipt

If you can get the W-9 and bank stub over today/Mon we should be able to hit your 2025-04-28 go-live. Note: if there are contract redlines, that will add time — Karthik, please flag any legal must-haves.

I've attached a redwood_po_example.pdf so you can verify invoice fields in advance. Also please confirm the billing email where invoices will be sent.

Best,
